{{Quote|What of your littermates, the other Rasi Tuums? Are they&hellip;''"<br />"''Ahn died by the hands of the Sith, but Zho still lives.|[[Azlyn Rae]] and Rasi Tuum|<ref name="Legacy 25" />}}
The [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] '''Zho''', one of the [[Rasi Tuum family|'''Rasi Tuums''']], was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[New Jedi Order]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. He was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before into a [[Litter (biology)|litter]] with two other Cathar, [[Ahn Rasi Tuum|Ahn]] and another known only as [[Rasi Tuum]]. All three survived a [[Battle of Coruscant (Sith–Imperial War)|joint]] [[Massacre at Ossus|massacre]] of the Jedi by the [[One Sith]] in [[130 ABY]], but their Order became scattered across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and Ahn was [[Ambush on Daluuj|slain]] by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] agents [[137 ABY|seven years later]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. Zho set out into the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] to find other surviving Jedi to bring to a [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taivas]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|He is currently out in the galaxy, searching for other Jedi to bring here.|Rasi Tuum, speaking of his littermate Zho and the Jedi's Hidden Temple on Taivas|<ref name="Legacy 25" />}}
Zho was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] and one of the [[Rasi Tuum family|Rasi Tuums]], a [[Litter (biology)|litter]] that also included [[Ahn Rasi Tuum|Ahn]] and another known only as [[Rasi Tuum]]. He was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]]<ref name="Legacy 25" /> [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[130 ABY]]<ref name="Date">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]] establishes that [[Rasi Tuum]] and his littermates were active [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Sith–Imperial War)|Battle of Coruscant]], which is dated at [[130 ABY]] in [[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]].</ref> The three littermates were all [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and they joined the [[New Jedi Order]]<ref name="Legacy 0" /> prior to 130 ABY.<ref name="Date" /> Around that year, Zho had long [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that fell past his shoulders and a short beard. He was similar in appearance to the other Rasi Tuums.<ref name="Legacy 0" />

In 130 ABY, during the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the [[One Sith]] order scattered the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[Battle of Coruscant (Sith–Imperial War)|attacking]] [[Massacre at Ossus|their]] [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi]] [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Temples]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="Legacy 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> The three Rasi Tuums were among the survivors of the massacre,<ref name="Legacy 25" /> but the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] spent the next seven years actively [[Third Jedi Purge|hunting]] Jedi down.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Although Ahn was [[Ambush on Daluuj|killed]] by Sith agents in [[137 ABY]] in the middle of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Zho traveled the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after Ahn's [[Death/Legends|death]], searching for other surviving Jedi to bring to the safety of a [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Taivas]].<ref name="Legacy 25" />

==Behind the scenes==
Along with his littermates Ahn and Rasi Tuum, Zho was created by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]] for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''. In [[June]] [[2006]], an image of the three Cathar that was simply labeled "Rasi Tuum" appeared in [[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]], a special preview of the series that was published prior to the release of the [[Legacy (2006) 1|first issue]].<ref name="Legacy 0" /> One of the Rasi Tuums appeared and was killed in the [[Legacy (2006) 2|second issue]],<ref name="Legacy 2">[[Legacy (2006) 2|''Legacy'' (2006) 2]]</ref> and the character was only revealed to be Ahn in [[Legacy (2006) 25|issue 25]], which was published in [[2008]] and was also the first source to explicitly mention Zho. Although [[Azlyn Rae]]'s dialogue referred to Zho and Anh as "the other Rasi Tuums,"<ref name="Legacy 25" /> no source has indicated if it is part of their names.
